description: Create a rule on a feed. The definition is validated, the standard preview runs server-side, and the report comes back WITH the created rule: match/change/exclusion counts, per-field tallies, warnings, and audit deltas. Show the human this report; danger-level warnings mean the rule can empty required fields or exclude heavily. The rule remains a draft until a person approves it in the app. Same definition format as preview_rule.

definition.description: The rule definition JSON (same format as preview_rule).

name: create_rule
title: Create rule
